volume_model.allocation: Pixel storage weights normalized to analytical 38x38 total; Sy fixed with depth within a column

validation.method: 5 folds of 10km spatial blocks; all repeated site observations aggregated before split
validation.note: Model-selection CV and EC sensitivity, not an independent 95% CI or validation of depth assumptions

covariates.geology_repair: Shapely make_valid before clipping; original source retained unchanged

limitations: EC-only drinking salinity screen; not potability certification
Agriculture: EC ceiling plus avoidance of FAO severe EC/SAR infiltration restriction; not crop-specific yield or full water suitability
Vertical allocation is a scenario; surface imagery does not measure deep EC
Volumes are potential drainable storage, not sustainable abstraction
Outside convex hull or validated-distance support remains unknown; unknown is never assigned fresh water
Depth-scenario and EC-error ranges are sensitivity ranges, not statistical confidence intervals

public_source_metadata.s2_sampling: Three least-cloudy scenes per MGRS tile in the reference window; reflectance resampled to 250m before indices, median then 1km averaging; NOT an annual vegetation mean
public_source_metadata.interpretation: Explanatory surface covariates, NOT measured groundwater EC or a vertical salinity profile

geology.scale_note: Regional lithology assembled at target 1:1M; not local borehole geology

units_assumed.ec: uS/cm, treated as EC25; source temperature correction not documented
units_assumed.utm: WGS84 north; original datum not documented
